questions: why does an app ask permission
answer: Android permissions control access to sensitive features such as the microphone, camera, location, and notifications. Grant only permissions needed for a feature you choose to use.

questions: how do i protect my password
answer: Use a long, unique password for every account, enable two-step verification, and never share passwords or one-time codes. Be cautious with unexpected links and requests for money.

questions: how can i identify a scam
answer: Phishing is an attempt to trick you into revealing passwords, codes, or money through fake messages or websites. Verify requests using an official app or contact channel instead of trusting unexpected links.
